'''Sizzribb''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Poakie]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies, and evolves into [[Lickflicker]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Loves to press close to the ground, silently sensing distant vibrations as well as changes in temperature and humidity. Whether it's the best resting spot in camp or the newest [[Zobos|Zobo]] hideout, Sizzribb can always tell beforehand, although it'll take some time to actually get moving."

Sizzribb is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
An orange and red frog with a white underside and yellow eyes. Its has dark brown, horizontal slit pupils and 3 red teardrop shaped crests on its chest.

Sizzribb's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form changes its eyes and chest crests to blue.

== Evolution Trial ==
Sizzribb's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Lickflicker]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Sizzribb to increase stats 3 time(s).
* In [[Island Goldrush]], use Energy Drink x5,000.

== Trivia ==
* Sizzribb and its evolutions were added to the game on 07/15/2026 alongside [[Hychroma]] and [[Ecstamira]].
